annotations.title: Business days in bulk (US federal holidays)

description: Business days in bulk (US federal holidays) — Up to 100 business-day calculations in one call. items = entries separated by ; or | or newlines: START..END counts business days between two dates (start excluded, end included; add inclusive=true to count both), START+N or START-N adds or subtracts N business days. Skips weekends and US federal holidays with OPM observed-date rules (holidays=none to skip only weekends). Each result lists the holidays hit; bad items get an error without failing the call. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_business_days_batch
